* Save and InvestSpaceX's IPO could be the largest-ever public offering—what to know. # Retail investors will get access to SpaceX's IPO—here's what to know before buying. Retail investors can expect access to this summer's most anticipated initial public offering — and possibly the largest ever. But you may not be able to buy all the shares you want, experts say, and it's not a smart move for all investors. If you want to get in on SpaceX, or any IPO, you'd be wise to do some homework on how these stocks tend to behave, Schuster and other experts say. ## How retail investors get access to IPOs. If SpaceX ends up bringing more retail investors into the fold than usual, it might be for a couple of reasons, Ritter says. For one thing, he says, SpaceX's sister company Tesla has a large share of its outstanding shares held by retail investors, and Musk may want to repeat that model with SpaceX.

## Markets Insider's Post. ### **Markets Insider**. Retail investors are expected to play a big role in SpaceX's upcoming IPO, but that means it's likely to be more volatile than other trading debuts.
